verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Abacum serves an llms.txt at https://www.abacum.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. Its content is an agent-readable product summary covering integrations, multi-entity roll-ups, and the demo, but it is marketing-level rather than technical documentation. Markdown doc variants (.md) return 404 and no OpenAPI spec exists. missing for 10: markdown/agent-oriented doc pages, technical or API reference content linked from llms.txt, independent corroboration of agent usefulness
